chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ, from al-Washshāʾ, from one whom he mentioned, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.

That he disliked the leftover drink of the child born of zina, the Jew, the Christian, the polytheist, and everyone who opposes Islam; and the most severe of that in his view was the leftover drink of the nāṣib.

key_terms.النَّاصِبِ: one who bears enmity toward the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.الْإِسْلَامَ: Islam, the religion contrasted here with opposition to it
key_terms.سُؤْرَ: leftover drink or what remains in a vessel after someone has drunk from it

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith in Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām say about the leftover drink of non-Muslims and the nāṣib?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal dislike regarding the leftover drink of certain categories of people outside or opposed to Islam. It places special emphasis on the leftover drink of the nāṣib as being the most severely regarded among them.
